Job Summary

Lead and control the planning, scheduling, and execution monitoring of logistics improvement projects, infrastructure upgrades, and operational initiatives in PLSS. Ensure that each project is executed on time, within scope, and aligned with Petrosea’s operational goals and budget framework.

Job Responsibilities

Key
Metric

Develop and monitor detailed project schedules and execution plans for logistics and warehouse improvement initiatives.
projects tracked against baseline schedule with no critical path deviation.

Coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure timely project execution, resource availability, and risk mitigation.
project milestones delivered on time with no major delays.

Monitor and report on logistics performance, material movements, and issue resolution to improve operational efficiency.
Weekly reports submitted on time

Maintain and actively implement SHE programs and responsibility (involve identify, mitigate and monitor SHE risk), including SHE Management System to ensure the effectiveness of the programs conform to official standard, requirements and procedure applied and to confirm the execution of the SHE Responsibility meet the intended outcome
- SHE risk well maintained

- Target Zero LTI

- SHE Management System meets the current ISO 14001, ISO 45001, SMK3 & SMKP standards and requirements

Education

Bachelor’s Degree in Industrial Engineering, Logistics, Project Management, or related discipline.

Skill, Knowledge, and Experience

• 5–8 years of experience in project control, operations planning, or execution monitoring, preferably in logistics, mining, or EPC environments.
• Strong understanding of project scheduling tools (Primavera/MS Project) and ERP systems.
• Experience in managing cross-functional improvement or infrastructure projects.
• Capable of identifying risks and managing mitigation plans.
• Familiarity with budgeting, cost control, and performance tracking.
• Strong communication and coordination skills with operational teams.
• English proficiency is an advantage.

Certification

Project Management Certification (CAPM, PRINCE2, or equivalent – preferred)

Other Requirements

About Us

INDICO is Telkomsel Group’s digital company, focused on developing and scaling digital platforms beyond core connectivity.

As part of Telkomsel Group, INDICO enables collaboration to support end-to-end digital use cases, ranging from customer engagement and transactions to loyalty, commerce, and data intelligence.

Through its platforms, INDICO transforms group capabilities into scalable and repeatable solutions that support Telkomsel’s digital growth and unlock new business opportunities across the ecosystem.

INDICO believe we can reach beyond to empower Indonesians and enable businesses through our strong core values of EPIC WAY (Excellence, Positivity, Impactful Collaboration, Customer First, Walk the Talk, Accountability, Yes-if Mindset).

Job Description

• Manage stock availability and ensure sufficient inventory to support business and sales activities.
• Calculate stock requirements and working capital needs.
• Monitor inventory levels and identify potential shortages or excess stock.
• Monitor and analyze sales transaction performance.
• Coordinate with Sales, Finance, and Operations teams to ensure stock availability aligns with business demand.
• Prepare and maintain stock and sales-related reports.

Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business, Management, Finance, or related field.
• 2-4 years of experience in Inventory Management, Stock Management, Supply Chain, Operations, or a related role.
• Understanding inventory management and stock planning.
• Strong numerical and analytical skills.
• Good understanding of working capital and inventory turnover.
• Proficient in Microsoft Excel/Google Sheets. Experience with ERP/inventory management systems is a plus.
• Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills.
• Able to analyze sales data and translate it into inventory requirements.
• Good coordination and communication skills.
